story: On Tuesday morning, Ben visits his grandparent. It is a cold day, so they sit outside on a wide bench. Ben is a little boy wearing black trousers. He puts on a shoe without his socks. They eat sweet pasta and drink hot coffee. The coffee has a very good smell. They agree that the morning is nice.
title: A Tuesday Morning
setting: A sunny garden outside a house.

characters.name: Ben
characters.look: A little boy with short brown hair and a blue shirt.

characters.name: Grandparent
characters.look: An old man with white hair and glasses.

sentences.en: It is a sunny Tuesday morning.
sentences.zh: 这是一个阳光明媚的星期二早晨。
sentences.scene_prompt: A bright sun rises over a green garden on a Tuesday morning.

sentences.en: The morning air is very cold.
sentences.scene_prompt: Ben and the old man sit in a garden with visible cold mist in the air.

sentences.en: Ben is a little boy with brown hair.
sentences.zh: 本是一个棕色头发的小男孩。
sentences.scene_prompt: Ben, a little boy with short brown hair, stands in the garden.

sentences.en: He visits his kind grandparent today.
sentences.zh: 他今天去拜访他亲切的祖父母。
sentences.scene_prompt: Ben walks toward an old man with white hair and glasses.

sentences.en: Ben wears black trousers and a shirt.
sentences.zh: 本穿着黑色的裤子和一件衬衫。
sentences.scene_prompt: Ben is wearing black trousers and a blue shirt.

sentences.en: He puts a shoe on without socks.
sentences.zh: 他没穿袜子就穿上了鞋子。
sentences.scene_prompt: Ben is putting a shoe on his foot without any socks.

sentences.en: They sit outside on a wide bench.
sentences.zh: 他们坐在一个宽阔的长凳上。
sentences.scene_prompt: Ben and the old man sit on a wide wooden bench outside.

sentences.en: They eat sweet pasta and hot coffee.
sentences.zh: 他们吃甜甜的面条和热咖啡。
sentences.scene_prompt: Ben and the old man eat bowls of pasta and drink coffee at a table.

sentences.en: The coffee has a very good smell.
sentences.zh: 咖啡有一种非常好闻的气味。
sentences.scene_prompt: Steam rises from two cups of hot coffee on the table.

sentences.en: They agree that the food is sweet.
sentences.zh: 他们都觉得食物是甜的。
sentences.scene_prompt: Ben and the old man smile at each other over their breakfast.
